overview.description: The Schwab Intermediate-Term US Treasury ETF (SCHR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Bloomberg US Treasury (3-10 Y) index. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of investment grade debt issued by the US Treasury with remaining maturity of 3-10 years. SCHR was launched on Aug 5, 2010 and is issued by Charles Schwab.
